resources.string: Create simple native documents. No photo editing or full Office editor. Nothing is written to a project automatically.

XLSX: tab-separated cells, up to 1000 rows × 50 columns; cell limit 32767 characters. PPTX: separate slides with a line containing --- (32 slides, 4000 characters each). Charts: one label:number per line, up to 32 nonnegative values ≤ 1e12; labels ≤ 80 characters; Persian/Arabic digits accepted. ZIP contains exactly one file: content.txt. Code exports literal UTF-8 .txt. Output limit: 8 MiB; PDF: 100 pages. Inputs that exceed limits are rejected.
PDF：第一页；PNG：图表图像；文本和 SVG：内容；DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和 ZIP：从实际生成的文件提取文字预览，不提供完整 Office 排版预览。
